purpose: Display-only provisional assembly; no robot commands, TCP or control URDF changes.
units: translation in mm; RPY angles in degrees (Rz yaw * Ry pitch * Rx roll)

alignment.method: Coincide radial hole axes; retain the 0.4 mm shoulder discrepancy instead of shifting the holes apart.
alignment.initial_orientation: Both grippers rotate 90 degrees relative to the flange so their jaw separation axes run from the left arm to the right arm (base -Y) at the zero arm pose; flange radial hole alignment is preserved.
